title: How much do Malaysians earn?
subtitle: Median & mean monthly salary in Malaysia, 2024
question: What is the median salary in Malaysia?
answer: In 2024, the median monthly salary for Malaysian citizens was RM2,793 and the mean was RM3,652 — up 7.3% and 6.1% from 2023.

source.notes: Figures refer to Malaysian citizens. From 2020 onward, estimates are based on the Population & Housing Census of Malaysia 2020. Median = the middle earner; mean = the average.

takeaways: The median (RM2,793) sits well below the mean (RM3,652) — a sign that higher earners pull the average up, so "average salary" overstates what a typical Malaysian makes.
Salaries dipped in 2020 during the pandemic (median fell from RM2,442 to RM2,076) and only passed the pre-COVID level again around 2022–2023.
A tertiary education roughly doubles the median salary versus secondary (RM4,131 vs RM2,046).
A gender gap persists: women's median salary is about 7% below men's.

faq.q: What is the median salary in Malaysia in 2024?
faq.a: The median monthly salary for Malaysian citizens was RM2,793 in 2024, according to the Department of Statistics Malaysia (DOSM). The mean (average) was RM3,652.

faq.q: What is the average salary in Malaysia?
faq.a: The mean monthly salary was RM3,652 in 2024 (DOSM). Note the median — RM2,793 — better reflects a typical earner, because a minority of high earners raises the average.

faq.q: How much did salaries grow in 2024?
faq.a: Median monthly salary rose 7.3% and mean rose 6.1% versus 2023, per DOSM's Salaries & Wages Survey Report 2024.
